quote_or_summary: PowerAgentBench is a power-system LLM/tool-agent benchmark with N-1 audit/mitigation and N-2 contingency search tasks, hidden evaluator and metrics such as violation reduction, evidence rate and validated recall.

EnergyAgentBench benchmarks LLM agents on live energy infrastructure data for siting, LCOE, portfolio optimization and causal grid diagnosis; it is energy-infrastructure planning rather than physical grid operation.
Grid2Op/L2RPN is a Python sequential decision environment/competition ecosystem for operating power grids with topology/redispatch-like actions and episode scoring.
pandapower is Python-native, pandas-based and supports power flow, OPF, contingency analysis, short circuit, state estimation, controllers and time series, making it a strong deterministic substrate.
PGLib-OPF and PowerModels.jl provide rigorous OPF benchmark cases/formulations, useful for feasibility/objective scoring but less Python-native and not an agent environment by themselves.
OpenDSS/DSS-Extensions is a strong public distribution-system substrate for unbalanced feeder, Volt/VAR, DER and time-series studies via Python bindings.
ANDES is an open Python package supporting power flow, time-domain simulation/transient stability, eigenvalue analysis, continuation PF and state estimation; relevant for dynamics-focused tasks.
